_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes: Adds Manual simulator settings: apply one BP, heart rate, volume, waveform and envelope shift without a sweep or cuff protocol. Pump, Vent and existing protocols remain available. Simulator stop is separate from cuff STOP. Existing sweep, preview, recording and MAP tools remain. Firmware and calibration are unchanged.
